title: OpenHat iOS Max Privacy — change catalog
disclaimer: A website cannot read iPhone Settings. This catalog is what the profile will write versus Apple defaults, plus every leftover tap from the four source guides. Live state is only in Settings on the phone.

items.title: Encrypted DNS over HTTPS (system-wide)
items.after: Mullvad Adblock DoH (or Quad9 if you install that file)
items.verify: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → DNS / OpenHat Max Privacy
items.notes: Hides DNS from the carrier and blocks ads/trackers (Mullvad Adblock). iOS only uses one DNS profile.

items.title: Optional DNS: Quad9 instead of Mullvad
items.verify: Same DNS screen; server should show dns.quad9.net
items.notes: Swiss malware-blocking resolver. Installing it replaces the Mullvad profile (same identifier).

items.title: Share iPhone Analytics
items.verify: Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements → Share iPhone Analytics
items.notes: If the toggle is greyed out after install, the profile owns it.

items.title: Lock analytics toggle so it cannot be turned back on
items.verify: Same Analytics screen; toggle should be disabled on a supervised device
items.notes: Ignored on a normal personal iPhone.

items.title: Share iCloud Analytics
items.verify: Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements → Share iCloud Analytics
items.notes: No separate profile key; turn it off next to iPhone Analytics.

items.title: Improve Siri & Dictation
items.verify: Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements → Improve Siri & Dictation
items.notes: Profile also forces on-device dictation so audio is not sent to Siri servers.

items.title: Apple personalized ads
items.verify: Settings → Privacy & Security → Apple Advertising → Personalized Ads

items.title: Allow Apps to Request to Track
items.notes: forceLimitAdTracking also disables the tracking prompt.

items.title: Dictation stays on-device
items.verify: Keyboard dictation still works; no Siri server round-trip for dictation

items.title: External Apple Intelligence / ChatGPT-style integrations
items.verify: Apple Intelligence settings; external model providers unavailable
items.notes: Apple currently allows this on unsupervised devices; they say it will require supervision later.

items.title: iCloud Backup
items.apple_default: On if iCloud is signed in
items.notes: Use encrypted Finder/iTunes backups instead. forceEncryptedBackup is also set.

items.title: Encrypt computer backups
items.verify: Finder or iTunes backup dialog requires a password

items.title: iCloud Drive / document sync
items.notes: Apple marked this supervised-only on newer iOS; still included. Confirm in Settings.

items.title: iCloud Keychain
items.verify: Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Passwords and Keychain
items.notes: Use Bitwarden or Proton Pass instead, as both guides recommend.

items.title: Shared Photo Stream / iCloud Shared Albums
My Photo Stream
items.notes: Deprecated on iOS 17+; harmless if ignored.

items.title: Siri / Spotlight internet suggestions
items.verify: Settings → Apple Intelligence & Siri → Suggestions from Apple / Content from Apple

items.title: Auto Unlock with Watch / nearby Apple devices
Managed apps iCloud sync
items.verify: Only relevant if MDM apps are present

items.title: Enterprise book backup / metadata sync
items.notes: Paired with allowEnterpriseBookMetadataSync=false.

items.title: Remote screen observation (Classroom)
items.verify: Classroom app cannot observe the screen

items.title: Treat AirDrop as unmanaged
items.verify: n/a on a personal phone without MDM

items.title: Require pairing password for outgoing AirPlay
items.verify: AirPlay to a TV prompts for a password

items.title: Trust Enterprise Developer button
items.after: Off — unsigned enterprise apps cannot be newly trusted
items.verify: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management (no Trust button)
items.notes: Does not revoke trust already granted. Blocks a common malware sideload path.

items.title: Safari fraudulent website warning
items.verify: Settings → Apps → Safari → Fraudulent Website Warning

items.title: Prevent Cross-Site Tracking (cookies)
items.verify: Settings → Apps → Safari → Prevent Cross-Site Tracking
items.notes: Value 1 = tracking prevention on; user can still enable Block All Cookies.

items.title: Reject untrusted HTTPS certificates without prompting
items.verify: Visiting a site with a bad cert fails closed
items.notes: Stops a class of captive-portal and MITM prompts. Hotel Wi-Fi login pages may break until you use the captive-portal sheet.

items.title: Control Center on Lock Screen
items.verify: Lock the phone and swipe for Control Center — it should not appear

items.title: Notification Center history on Lock Screen
items.verify: Lock screen cannot open past notifications
items.notes: Also set Show Previews to When Unlocked manually.

items.title: Today View / Search on Lock Screen
items.verify: Cannot swipe to Today View while locked

items.title: Siri while locked
items.verify: Side button Siri does nothing on the lock screen

items.title: Siri entirely off
items.verify: Apple Intelligence & Siri missing or disabled
items.notes: On a normal iPhone, turn Siri off manually (see manual list).

items.title: Dictation off
items.verify: Microphone key on keyboard has no dictation
items.notes: Unsupervised devices still get on-device-only dictation from the other key.

items.title: AirDrop off
items.notes: On a normal iPhone set Receiving Off manually. Use LocalSend for local sharing.

items.title: Game Center
items.verify: Game Center icon gone on a supervised device

items.title: Game Center friends / multiplayer / chat
items.notes: Also allowMultiplayerGaming=false.

items.title: Apple News
items.notes: On a normal iPhone, delete or ignore News and turn off its Siri Learn From This App.

items.title: Find My Friends / Share My Location
items.verify: Settings → [your name] → Find My → Share My Location
items.notes: Also allowFindMyFriendsModification=false. Do this manually on a normal iPhone.

items.title: App Clips
items.verify: NFC / Safari App Clips do not install

items.title: Third-party app marketplaces
items.notes: EU sideloading. Also allowWebDistributionAppInstallation=false.

items.title: Automatic app downloads from other devices
items.verify: Settings → Apps → App Store → Automatic Downloads → Apps
items.notes: Turn this off manually on a normal iPhone. App Updates stay on.

items.title: Set up nearby new devices (and iOS→Android transfer)
items.verify: No prompt to set up a nearby new device

items.title: iCloud Keychain AutoFill
items.notes: Turn AutoFill off manually and use Bitwarden. Third-party managers still work when this key is false.

items.title: Safari AutoFill (contacts / cards / passwords)
items.notes: Disable Use Contact Info and Credit Cards manually on a normal iPhone.

items.title: Require Face ID / passcode before AutoFill
Live Voicemail (processed in the cloud on some versions)
RCS messaging (not end-to-end encrypted like iMessage)
items.notes: Turn RCS off manually on a normal iPhone. Prefer Signal.

items.title: FaceTime remote control of this device
USB pairing with computers
items.notes: Blocks a common forensic/extraction path. Also turn off USB Accessories on Lock Screen manually.

items.title: Set Date & Time automatically (locked on)
items.verify: Settings → General → Date & Time → Set Automatically
items.notes: Keep this on manually. Wrong clocks break TLS.

items.title: Lookup / definition (sends highlighted text to Apple)
Genmoji / Image Playground / Image Wand / Writing Tools
items.notes: Also allowImagePlayground, allowImageWand, allowWritingTools, allowPersonalizedHandwritingResults, allowAppleIntelligenceReport, Mail/Notes/Safari summaries.

items.title: Mail smart replies / summaries
items.notes: Also allowMailSummary=false.

items.title: Notes transcription / summary
items.notes: Also allowNotesTranscriptionSummary=false.

items.title: Location Services master switch
items.notes: Apple will not let a profile flip this. Required for emergency/Find My accuracy if you leave Find My on.

items.title: Significant Locations — clear and off
items.verify: Location Services → System Services → Significant Locations

items.title: Location System Services (analytics, routing, cell search, timezone, networking)
items.after: Off: iPhone Analytics, Routing & Traffic, Improve Maps, Setting Time Zone, Networking & Wireless, Cell Network Search, System Customization, Location-Based Alerts/Suggestions, Compass Calibration, Device Management, HomeKit, Motion Calibration (if unused)
items.notes: Leave Status Bar Icon on so you can see when something still uses GPS.

items.title: Lockdown Mode
items.notes: Requires passcode. A profile cannot enable this.

items.title: Sign out of iCloud / Apple ID, or strip every iCloud toggle
items.notes: If you keep iCloud: Advanced Data Protection on, Access iCloud Data on the Web off, 2FA / security keys on, communication emails off, Personalized Recommendations off.

items.title: iCloud Photos
items.after: Off — do this yourself after photos are downloaded
items.apple_default: On if iCloud Photos is enabled
items.notes: A profile key exists (allowCloudPhotoLibrary=false) but Apple deletes local copies that were not fully downloaded. Too dangerous to automate.

items.title: Find My iPhone
items.after: Left on (theft recovery). Turn off only if your threat model prefers that.
items.notes: celenityy recommends off. We do not force it: a stolen unsupervised phone with Find My off is gone.

items.title: Private Wi-Fi Address + Limit IP Address Tracking
items.after: On for every network you use
items.verify: Settings → Wi-Fi → (i) next to the network
items.notes: Must be set per network. A Wi-Fi payload could do this only if we knew your SSID and password.

items.title: Ask to Join Networks off; Auto-Join Hotspot Never
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth off when unused; Airplane Mode when idle
items.after: Off when you are not using them
items.notes: A profile cannot schedule radios.

items.title: Siri Listen for / Press Side Button off; all Apple suggestions off
items.notes: Required on a normal iPhone because allowAssistant is supervised-only.

items.title: AirDrop Receiving Off; no cellular for AirDrop
Continuity Camera off; Automatically AirPlay → Never; AirPlay Receiver off
items.notes: Handoff itself is also forced off by the profile.

items.title: Lock Screen: USB Accessories, Live Activities, Home Control, Return Missed Calls off
items.after: All Allow Access When Locked off
items.verify: Settings → Face ID & Passcode → Allow Access When Locked
items.notes: Control Center, Notification Center, Today View, and Wallet are already forced off by the profile.

items.title: Long alphanumeric passcode; optional Face ID off; Erase Data on; Require Immediately
items.after: Custom alphanumeric; Face ID off if your threat model needs it; Erase Data on
items.notes: Optional extra file OpenHat-Passcode.mobileconfig enforces min length 6, no simple PINs, lock immediately. It will refuse to install until the passcode complies.

items.title: Notification previews: When Unlocked; Screen Sharing notifications off
Focus: do not share across devices or share Focus Status
Device name: generic (not your real name)
items.notes: Visible on some networks.

items.title: Automatic iOS updates + Rapid Security Responses on
items.verify: Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic Updates
items.notes: Delay major version jumps a few weeks; install 15.x.y / 16.x.y patches immediately.

items.title: Background App Refresh: off except messaging
App Store: auto app downloads off, updates on, video autoplay off, in-app ratings off
Safari: DuckDuckGo, suggestions off, ad measurement off, camera/mic/location Deny, Hide IP from Trackers, Advanced Tracking on All Browsing
items.notes: Also set Downloads to On My iPhone, Close Tabs After One Day, Block Pop-ups (profile helps), no AutoFill.

items.title: Audit Camera, Mic, Contacts, Photos (never All Photos), Bluetooth, Local Network, Speech, Motion
items.notes: A profile cannot revoke existing third-party grants.

items.title: App Privacy Report on
items.verify: Settings → Privacy & Security → App Privacy Report
items.notes: This is the closest built-in view of which servers apps contact. It is not a settings dump.

items.title: Per-app: Learn from this App / Suggest App / Show on Home Screen off
items.after: Off for every app, especially App Store, Safari, Maps, Photos, Health, TV

items.title: iMessage / FaceTime reachable only at your phone number, not email; RCS off
items.verify: Settings → Apps → Messages → Send & Receive; FaceTime; RCS
items.notes: We do not disable iMessage in the profile (allowChat would brick Messages on supervised phones).

items.title: Share Name and Photo off; Calendar location suggestions off; Reminders suggestions off
Maps: Ratings and Photos off; photo providers off
items.verify: Settings → Apps → Maps → Contribute to Maps

items.title: Photos: Shared Albums off, cellular off, featured content off, Use Passcode on Hidden album
TV: Use Play History off; autoplay next off
Shortcuts: iCloud Sync off, Private Sharing off, Allow Running Scripts off
Translate: cellular off, On-Device Mode on
items.notes: Profile already forces on-device translation.

items.title: Detect Compromised Passwords on; Delete After Use on
items.notes: Detect Compromised Passwords is local. Prefer Bitwarden as default manager.

items.title: Screen Time Content & Privacy Restrictions (optional second lock)
items.after: On: don't allow tracking requests, Apple Advertising, Share My Location, Speech Recognition, Bluetooth Sharing; Siri web search don't allow
items.verify: Settings → Screen Time → Content & Privacy Restrictions
items.notes: Overlaps the profile. Useful on a normal iPhone where supervised keys are ignored.

items.title: Wallet compatible cards / unused Apple Pay merchant ID off
items.after: Off if you do not use Apple Pay
items.verify: Settings → Wallet & Apple Pay; Location System Services → Apple Pay Merchant Identification

items.title: iMessage Contact Key Verification on (if you keep iMessage)
No-logs VPN: Mullvad, IVPN, or Proton VPN, always-on
items.verify: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → VPN
items.notes: ios-profile-builder can emit a VPN payload, but only if you already have a server and credentials. We will not bake a third-party account into this file.

items.title: Optional: AdGuard Pro or Lockdown Privacy as a local DNS firewall + Safari content blockers
items.after: Installed if you want per-app query logs on top of system DoH
items.notes: System encrypted DNS (this profile) already blocks trackers without consuming the VPN slot. AdGuard Pro uses a local VPN and will conflict with a real VPN unless you pick one.

items.title: Firefox Focus or Brave as default browser; Safari only for persistent logins
items.after: Focus/Brave default; telemetry off inside the app
items.verify: Settings → Apps → Safari → Default Browser App

items.title: Bitwarden or Proton Pass instead of iCloud Keychain
Proton Mail (or Tuta) instead of Gmail/Outlook apps
items.after: Proton app for encrypted mail; built-in Mail for conventional accounts
items.notes: Do not install Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo apps.

items.title: Signal for messaging; Standard Notes for notes; MySudo for burner numbers
LocalSend for local file/clipboard share (no Apple ID)
items.notes: AirDrop has no public plugin API. Universal Clipboard requires the same iCloud account.

items.title: MDM enrollment payload
items.notes: ios-profile-builder can emit com.apple.mdm. That gives a remote server control of the phone — the opposite of this project.

items.title: Custom Root CA
items.notes: A custom CA enables HTTPS interception. We will not ship one.

items.title: Wi-Fi payload with your home SSID
items.notes: Needs your SSID and password. Set Private Address per network instead.

items.title: Force-disable iMessage (allowChat)
items.after: Left available; tighten Send & Receive manually
items.notes: celenityy says turn iMessage off if unused. allowChat is supervised and would remove iMessage entirely, which is too sharp for a default profile.

items.title: Force-disable Face ID / Touch ID
items.after: Your choice in Face ID & Passcode
items.notes: allowFingerprintForUnlock=false is too easy to lock people out of a daily driver. Do it manually if your threat model needs it.

items.title: iCloud Private Relay / Mail Privacy Protection
items.after: Left on — these are privacy features
items.verify: Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Private Relay; Mail Privacy Protection
items.notes: A profile can disable them. We do not.

items.title: Dark Mode, Night Shift, True Tone, Reduce Motion, battery percentage
items.notes: In celenityy's guide as comfort/battery, not telemetry. A profile cannot set most of these anyway.

items.title: Force Apple Watch wrist detection
items.after: On if a Watch is paired
items.verify: Watch unlocks only while on wrist
items.notes: Stops a removed Watch from unlocking the iPhone.

items.title: Safari deny list for tracker / social-graph sites
items.verify: Safari cannot open facebook.com / instagram.com / doubleclick.net etc.
items.notes: Safari only. Native Instagram/Snapchat apps ignore this. Separate file so a filter rejection cannot break the main profile.

items.title: Supervise the iPhone with Apple Configurator (no MDM, no paid Developer Program)
items.verify: Settings → General → About → Supervised (or the profile applies AirDrop/Siri/app blocks)
items.notes: USB + a Mac. Erases the device. Unlocks the 47 supervised keys already in the standard profile AND the Instagram/Snapchat block list. See CONFIGURATOR.md.

items.title: Delete high-tracking apps (Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Snapchat, TikTok, X, Pinterest, Reddit, LinkedIn)
items.after: Deleted, or Screen Time → Never Allow, or Supervised profile after Configurator
items.verify: Home Screen / App Library; data/tracker-apps.json has bundle IDs
items.notes: A Safari-installed profile cannot hide these apps. That is Apple, not a missing payload.
